Synthetic Clinical, EMA, and Educational Research Notes Dataset

Source: R/data.R
synthetic_notes.Rd

A 100 percent fictional teaching dataset containing realistic synthetic therapy session notes, ecological momentary assessment (EMA) journal entries, and educational student reflections engineered specifically for offline demonstrations, unit tests, and tutorials in airgapllm. All names, emails (@example.org), phone numbers (555-01xx NANP reserved range), street addresses, medical record numbers, social security numbers, ages over 89, and geographic ZIP codes are completely fabricated and correspond to no real individuals.

Usage

synthetic_notes

Format

A tibble with 16 rows and 6 columns:

note_id

Character unique note identifier ("SYN_001" to "SYN_016").

domain

Character research domain ("clinical_therapy", "ema_journal", or "student_writing").

site

Character fictional study site label ("Site_North", "Site_South", or "Site_West").

wave

Integer longitudinal assessment wave (1L or 2L).

contains_synthetic_phi

Logical indicator of whether the row intentionally embeds fictional PII/PHI patterns.

note_text

Character unstructured text body (including one multi-paragraph transcript for demonstrating chunk_clinical_texts() and HIPAA Safe Harbor edge cases such as ages > 89 and restricted 3-digit ZIP prefixes).

Source

100 percent synthetically constructed for airgapllm documentation and reproducible offline verification.

Examples

data("synthetic_notes", package = "airgapllm")
nrow(synthetic_notes)
#> [1] 16
pii_privacy_report(synthetic_notes, text_col = "note_text")
#> <airgap_privacy_report> (aggregate counts only; zero raw PII)
#>   Documents scanned:  16
#>   Documents with PII: 12 (75%)
#>   Total detections:   36
#>   By entity type:
#>     - age_over_89: 3 (2 docs, 12.5%)
#>     - date: 6 (6 docs, 37.5%)
#>     - email: 3 (3 docs, 18.75%)
#>     - ip_address: 1 (1 docs, 6.25%)
#>     - mrn_id: 4 (4 docs, 25%)
#>     - person_name: 8 (6 docs, 37.5%)
#>     - phone: 4 (4 docs, 25%)
#>     - ssn: 1 (1 docs, 6.25%)
#>     - street_address: 2 (2 docs, 12.5%)
#>     - zip_code: 4 (4 docs, 25%)
